title: ServiceChannelStatus - Data API
description: Represents the status that’s associated with a specific service channel. This object is available in API version 32.0 and later.

ServiceChannelId.description: The ID of the service channel.

ServicePresenceStatusId.description: The ID of the presence status that’s associated with the service channel that’s specified by the ServicePresenceChannelId.

special_access_rules:
To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled. As of Spring ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.
